scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),AdmZip=require('adm-zip');const a='NEXORA_V229_SITE_COMPLET.nxp',o='public';if(!fs.existsSync(a))throw new Error('Archive Nexora V229 introuvable');fs.rmSync(o,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(o,{recursive:true});new AdmZip(a).extractAllTo(o,true);for(const i of ['index.html','assets','modules','manifest.webmanifest','service-worker.js','offline.html'])if(!fs.existsSync(path.join(o,i)))throw new Error('Element obligatoire manquant: '+i);console.log('Nexora V229 complet prepare avec assets et modules');"
